title: Judgment on Sidon
description: The word of the Lord came to Ezekiel to prophesy against Sidon. The Lord will display his glory and holiness through judgment on the city by sending plague, blood in its streets, and sword. After the judgment, the house of Israel will no longer be troubled by hostile neighbors but will be gathered from the nations, return to the land God gave to Jacob, live securely, build houses, and plant vineyards.
